Container.Name: Tesserae
Container.Overview: E-ink dashboard server. Compose tile-based dashboards in the browser, render them server-side with headless Chromium and push them to e-ink panels over REST or MQTT (built-in broker on port 1883, off until enabled in Settings - Server - MQTT). Web UI on port 8765; the first visit sets the password and runs the onboarding wizard. Host networking keeps the LAN IP in render-frame URLs correct and enables mDNS (tesserae.local). Image is ~1 GB to pull.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, pages, schedules and backups. Losing this folder loses the whole install.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Recommended. Encrypts stored credentials (API keys, broker passwords, Home Assistant token). Generate once with: python3 -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))" and keep it out of the appdata backup. Without it the key is derived from settings.json and stored secrets are lost if that file is regenerated.
